snippet.title: Senara: The Sacrament - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Senara: The Sacrament, a first-person survival horror game developed by Influsion Inc. Players will board a demented ship with horrors around every corner. Find the missing crew, explore the sprawling ship, and gather clues to escape. Senara: The Sacrament is launching on July 30 for PC (Steam).
